title: Connecticut Judicial Ethics Informal Opinion 2008-11
text:
Committee on Judicial Ethics 2008-11 - CT Judicial Branch
Connecticut Committee on Judicial Ethics
Informal Opinion Summaries
2008-11 (October 10, 2008)
Advisory Opinions -
Jurisdiction
Policy and Rules
of Committee, Paragraph 6
The Committee received a request and determined
that, in accordance with paragraph 6 of its rules
(requiring the subject matter of a request not be
the subject of a matter “pending before a court,
agency or commission”), it lacked jurisdiction to
issue an opinion.
Committee on Judicial Ethics
21.1.1
